introduction.title: Introduction
introduction.text1: At VOID SMM, we are committed to protecting your privacy and ensuring the security of your personal information. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you use our social media management platform.
introduction.text2: By using our services, you agree to the collection and use of information in accordance with this policy. If you do not agree with our policies and practices, please do not use our services.

usageInformation.title: Usage Information
items: Social media account data (with your permission)

howWeUse.title: How We Use Your Information
items: To provide and maintain our services
To process payments and manage your account
To communicate with you about our services
To improve our platform and develop new features
To ensure security and prevent fraud

dataSecurity.title: Data Security
dataSecurity.text: We implement appropriate technical and organizational security measures to protect your personal information against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction. These measures include:
items: Secure data storage and transmission protocols

yourRights.title: Your Rights
yourRights.text: You have the following rights regarding your personal information:
items: Right to access your personal data
Right to erase your personal data
Right to restrict processing of your data

contact.title: Contact Us
contact.text: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy or our data practices, please contact us:

changes.title: Changes to This Policy
changes.text: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of any changes by posting the new Privacy Policy on this page and updating the "Last updated" date. You are advised to review this Privacy Policy periodically for any changes.

agreement.title: Agreement to Terms
agreement.text1: These Terms of Service ("Terms") govern your use of the VOID SMM platform and services. By accessing or using our services, you agree to be bound by these Terms.
agreement.text2: If you do not agree to these Terms, please do not use our services. We reserve the right to modify these Terms at any time, and your continued use of our services constitutes acceptance of any changes.

serviceDescription.title: Service Description
serviceDescription.text: VOID SMM provides a comprehensive social media management platform that includes:
items: Social media account management and automation

accountCreation.title: Account Creation
accountCreation.text: To use our services, you must create an account and provide accurate, complete information. You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account credentials.

accountResponsibilities.title: Account Responsibilities
items: You are responsible for all activities under your account
You must notify us immediately of any unauthorized use
You may not share your account with others

acceptableUse.title: Acceptable Use Policy
acceptableUse.text: You agree to use our services only for lawful purposes and in accordance with these Terms. You may not:
items: Violate any applicable laws or regulations
Attempt to gain unauthorized access to our systems
Use our services for spam or fraudulent activities
Interfere with the proper functioning of our services

billing.title: Billing
billing.text: Payment is required in advance for all services. All fees are non-refundable unless otherwise specified in our refund policy.

refunds.title: Refunds
refunds.text: Refunds are provided only in cases of service failure or technical issues on our end. Refund requests must be submitted within 30 days of the original purchase.

scope.title: Scope
scope.text: The Service may accept payments in fiat or cryptocurrencies. VOID SMM is a non-custodial platform, and all digital assets are sent directly to your wallet. The Service does not hold users' funds.

riskBased.title: Risk-Based Approach
riskBased.text: The Service applies a risk-based approach to monitoring transactions, proportionate to its size and stage of development. The focus is on identifying higher-risk activities, such as unusually large payments, repeated transactions inconsistent with normal service usage, or transactions linked to high-risk blockchain indicators.

suspiciousActivity.text: In case of suspicious activity, the Service reserves the right to:

compliance.title: Compliance with Applicable Laws
compliance.text: The Service aims to comply with applicable laws and regulations related to anti-money laundering (AML) and counter-terrorist financing (CTF) to the extent possible given its stage as a startup.

intellectualProperty.title: Intellectual Property
intellectualProperty.text1: The VOID SMM platform and all its content, features, and functionality are owned by VOID SMM and are protected by international copyright, trademark, and other intellectual property laws.
intellectualProperty.text2: You may not copy, modify, distribute, sell, or lease any part of our services without our express written permission.

limitationOfLiability.title: Limitation of Liability
limitationOfLiability.text: To the maximum extent permitted by law, VOID SMM shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, special, consequential, or punitive damages, including but not limited to loss of profits, data, or use, arising out of or relating to your use of our services.

termination.title: Termination
termination.text1: We may terminate or suspend your account immediately, without prior notice, for any reason, including if you breach these Terms.
termination.text2: Upon termination, your right to use our services will cease immediately, and we may delete your account and data.

contact.title: Contact Information
contact.text: If you have any questions about these Terms of Service, please contact us:

whatAreCookies.title: What Are Cookies
whatAreCookies.text1: Cookies are small text files that are stored on your device when you visit our website. They help us provide you with a better experience by remembering your preferences and enabling certain functionality.
whatAreCookies.text2: This Cookie Policy explains how VOID SMM uses cookies and similar technologies on our platform and how you can control them.

essential.title: Essential Cookies
essential.text: These cookies are necessary for the website to function properly. They enable basic functions like page navigation, access to secure areas, and authentication.

performance.title: Performance Cookies
performance.text: These cookies collect information about how visitors use our website, helping us improve performance and user experience.

functional.title: Functional Cookies
functional.text: These cookies enable enhanced functionality and personalization, such as remembering your preferences and settings.

marketing.title: Marketing Cookies
marketing.text: These cookies are used to track visitors across websites to display relevant and engaging advertisements.

howWeUse.title: How We Use Cookies
items: To ensure our website functions properly
To remember your login status and preferences
To analyze website traffic and usage patterns
To improve our services and user experience
To provide personalized content and features
To detect and prevent fraud and security threats

thirdParty.title: Third-Party Cookies
thirdParty.text1: We may use third-party services that set their own cookies. These include:
items: Google Analytics: For website analytics and performance monitoring
Social Media Platforms: For social sharing and integration features
Payment Processors: For secure payment processing
Customer Support: For live chat and support functionality
thirdParty.text2: These third parties have their own privacy policies and cookie practices. We recommend reviewing their policies for more information.

managing.title: Managing Your Cookie Preferences
managing.text: You have several options for managing cookies:

browserSettings.title: Browser Settings
browserSettings.text: Most web browsers allow you to control cookies through their settings. You can:
items: Set up notifications for new cookies

ourSettings.title: Our Cookie Settings
ourSettings.text: You can manage your cookie preferences through our cookie settings panel, accessible from the footer of our website.

duration.title: Cookie Duration
items: Session Cookies: Deleted when you close your browser
Persistent Cookies: Remain on your device for a set period
First-Party Cookies: Set by our website directly
Third-Party Cookies: Set by external services

impact.title: Impact of Disabling Cookies
impact.text: If you disable cookies, some features of our website may not function properly:
items: You may need to log in repeatedly
Your preferences may not be saved
Some interactive features may not work
Personalized content may not be available

updates.title: Updates to This Policy
updates.text1: We may update this Cookie Policy from time to time to reflect changes in our practices or for other operational, legal, or regulatory reasons.
updates.text2: We will notify you of any material changes by posting the updated policy on our website and updating the "Last updated" date.
